statement: N-0095 alias seal keys: a merged name is sealed under both keys resolvers look aliases up by, the punctuation-free SSOT key (customer_source_token_alias_key) and the plain lowercased key (_norm_key), when they differ. Options: (a) both keys, as built; (b) SSOT key only, relying on merge redirect for DSI and shipment lookups. Evidence: DSI _alias_customer_id and shipment lookups use _norm_key; on cip 112 plain-key aliases were missing for 216 merged names whose SSOT key was already sealed. Reversible: seal aliases carry the note prefix '[customer merge alias seal]'.
